item.tib: rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi dkar chag snang byed yid kyi mun sel rin po che'i rgyan 'phreng
item.coloph: de ltar gzhung lugs ji bzhin bkod pa'i (yi/)zhing rgyan zhing bkod rnam nges zhal bkod nyid/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis/ rnam 'byed blo ldan 'khrungs pa'i khyad par lags/ (?) legs par bskul ba'i don du/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i ming can gyis dge sding dpel chen rab gsal mngon dgar sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
